problem_statement: Build a brand-new /members team-directory page from scratch on the WaVer SaaS site (dunky11__react-saas-template, CRA + Material-UI + react-router-dom v5). The route /members does not exist in the baseline (it renders empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing MUI design system: a fixed top AppBar with the 'WaVer' brand wordmark, a centered hero titled 'Team Directory', a row of category filter buttons (All Members / Engineering / Design / Product), a section heading that reflects the active category plus a member count Chip, and a responsive Grid of member Cards (avatar initials + name + title). Reuse the shared Footer component. Wire the filter buttons as a genuine interaction: clicking a category updates BOTH the visible member cards AND the section heading (e.g. clicking 'Engineering' shows only engineering members under an 'Engineering Team' heading). The page must have no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Fixed AppBar with the 'WaVer' brand wordmark (primary 'Wa' + secondary 'Ver')
Centered hero with an h3 title 'Team Directory' and an intro line 'Meet the people building WaVer across engineering, design and product.'
A filter button row with four buttons: 'All Members', 'Engineering', 'Design', 'Product' (each carrying a data-role attribute)
A section heading (h3) that reads 'All Members' by default and a Chip showing the member count
A responsive MUI Grid of member Cards, each with an Avatar (initials), the member name and their title
Clicking a category filter button updates the visible cards AND the section heading (e.g. 'Engineering' -> 'Engineering Team')
The shared site Footer reused at the bottom
No horizontal overflow at mobile width
design_constraints: Reuse the existing MUI theme (primary #b3294e, secondary #4829B2, 'Baloo Bhaijaan' brand font)
Use MUI components already used across the site (AppBar, Toolbar, Typography, Container, Grid, Card, Button, Avatar, Chip)
Reuse the shared Footer component from logged_out/components/footer/Footer
Match the site's spacing/typography scale (theme.spacing, Typography variants)
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 在 /members 注册一个顶层空 Route(<Fragment/>),route 存在但内容为空; reference 在 src/members/MembersPage.js 完整实现该页并在 App.js 顶层挂载 /members; bad 复用 reference 结构但把 filter 交互写死 (active 常量='all', 去掉 onClick) —— dom_assertions 仍过但 interaction_assertion (点击 Engineering 后 h3 应变 'Engineering Team') 失败。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。CRA react-scripts 2.1.8, Node22 需 NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider; date-fns@2 作为 peer dep 需显式安装(源码 import date-fns/format 子路径)。
